page_title: ACM 3-0 LEC | AC Milan v Lecce 27/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's it for today, Luca Zufferli has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the middle of the goal, but Wladimiro Falcone is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
89' Lameck Banda (Lecce) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the bottom left corner, but Mike Maignan was alert and the score remains the same.
83' Substitution. Lassana Coulibaly makes way for Remi Oudin (Lecce).
82' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) perfectly wins the ball from the free kick, but his effort from the edge of the penalty area isn't accurate enough and the ball goes a few inches over the bar!
81' Lecce take the free kick with a short pass.
80' Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) is shown a red card by the referee for a horror tackle that simply has no place in football!
77' A brilliant cross into the box finds Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan), who directs his header to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper shows his reflexes and makes an astonishing save.
76' That's the end of the game for Tammy Abraham, who is replaced by Luka Jovic (AC Milan).
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) replaces Theo Hernandez.
74' Luca Zufferli blows his whistle and it's Lameck Banda (Lecce) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
73' Here is a change. Ante Rebic is going off and Luca Gotti gives the last tactical orders to Santiago Pierotti (Lecce).
73' The referee allows time for a substitution. Balthazar Pierret will be replaced by Hamza Rafia (Lecce).
72' Lameck Banda (Lecce) receives a decent pass inside the box and curls in an effort on goal, but the ball hits the outside of the right post and flies out of play.

71' OFF THE CROSSBAR! Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) runs towards the goal to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from the edge of the box, but it crashes against the crossbar. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
70' AC Milan take a short corner kick.

69' A lofted cross from Yunus Musah (AC Milan) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The referee points to the corner flag and AC Milan will take a corner.
67' The corner from Ante Rebic (Lecce) is hurriedly cleared.

67' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the bottom left corner, but Mike Maignan has other ideas and makes a brilliant save. Lecce win a corner.
67' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Ante Rebic (Lecce). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
67' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
65' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Antonino Gallo (Lecce) offside.
63' Paulo Fonseca has decided to make a change. Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) replaces Christian Pulisic.
63' Youssouf Fofana will be replaced by Yunus Musah (AC Milan).
62' Ante Rebic (Lecce) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly low towards the middle of the goal, but Mike Maignan is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
61' Chance! Tammy Abraham (AC Milan) took a nice pass in his stride in the box, but scuffed his shot just wide of the left post.
60' A clever short pass gives Rafael Leao (AC Milan) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball well wide of the right post.
59' Luca Gotti prepares a substitution. Tete Morente is replaced by Lameck Banda (Lecce).
57' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar.
55' Alvaro Morata is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan).
54' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 4:3.
52' Good defending. Rafael Leao (AC Milan) tries to find Christian Pulisic inside the box, but the pass is cut out.
51' Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
50' Ante Rebic (Lecce) is about to take a corner kick.
50' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. Lecce have been awarded a corner kick.
49' Luca Zufferli shows a yellow card to Emerson Royal (AC Milan) for his blatant foul.

48' The ball is laid off to Alvaro Morata (AC Milan) on the edge of the box. He shoots through a crowd of players towards the right side of the goal and forces Wladimiro Falcone to make a decent save.
46' Kialonda Gaspar (Lecce) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Mike Maignan intercepts the ball.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) gets into a great position in the box after a pass, but sends his shot just wide of the left post.
43' 3 - 0 Goal! Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low into the middle of the net. It's 3:0.

41' 2 - 0 GOAL! Superb work from Rafael Leao, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Theo Hernandez (AC Milan), who beats Wladimiro Falcone with a brilliant shot into the left side of the net. 2:0.

38' 1 - 0 Perfectly taken free kick!Theo Hernandez sends a cross in and Alvaro Morata (AC Milan) leaps high to connect with it on the edge of the 6-yard box. His close-range header goes into the top of the net and the score changes to 1:0.
34' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
34' Federico Baschirotto (Lecce) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
33' Ante Rebic (Lecce) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
27' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
27' Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
25' Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.

24' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.
23' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the middle of the goal, but Mike Maignan is equal to it and makes an easy save.
22' The foul by Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) was seen by Luca Zufferli who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
22' Corner kick. Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) is ready to send the ball into the box.
21' Ante Rebic (Lecce) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
19' Tammy Abraham (AC Milan) touches the ball with his hand.
18' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
15' Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) wastes a big opportunity! He controls the ball after a nice low pass and shoots from a promising distance. His poor effort goes miles wide of the left post.
13' A corner kick by AC Milan is thwarted by the well prepared Wladimiro Falcone (Lecce).
12' The resulting corner from Ante Rebic (Lecce) comes to nothing.

11' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the bottom right corner. Mike Maignan has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save. Lecce have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
9' Neat link-up play between Rafael Leao (AC Milan) and Alvaro Morata, but Wladimiro Falcone reads the game well and the move breaks down.
9' Ante Rebic (Lecce) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
8' The resulting corner from Ante Rebic (Lecce) is cleared. Lecce have been awarded a corner kick.

7' A cross by Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
7' Half-chance! Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) plays a pass into the box, but Mike Maignan reacts well to snuff out the attack.
4' Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) takes a neat pass, dummies a defender and slams the ball well wide of the left post from the edge of the box.
3' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) passes the ball onto Tammy Abraham, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.
2' Ante Rebic (Lecce) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Mike Maignan, who smothers the ball.
1' Ante Rebic (Lecce) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Luca Zufferli signals.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Lecce will kick-off.
